goal: Promote existing numeric aliases into active document declarations without changing requirements or audit source
non_goals: No runtime C/D, source/parser changes, installs, commits, private data, premium calls or delegation
global_invariants: Preserve immutable preimages and A/B artifacts; unchanged observable requirement wording, owners, gates and acceptance limits

allowed_operations: Edit only current documents and external migration mapping within Task 1
forbidden_actions: Change requirement meaning, historical artifacts, preimages, audit source, runtime or approvals; spawn agents; commit
required_approvals: Operator Do next step authorizes bounded previously proposed trace repair; existing Subagent-Driven choice retained

acceptance_criteria.expectation: One-to-one old-to-current mapping, unique numeric declarations, coherent current references, old bytes/digests/approval scope preserved, required trace audit passes without changing auditor

verification.command: Parent calls unchanged scripts/trace/index.ts run with --slug agent-harness-improvement --required --json; independent reviewer compares current docs with frozen preimages
verification.expected: No document trace issues and no semantic/authority change

stop_conditions: Need for behavioral change, new authority, private data or parser change

limits.scope: One bounded document correction; no exact host monetary limit exposed
